synopsis: GOOSE is listed among the off-road datasets considered in the research, but its status was not verified [f5849, f12815]. Chapter 7 and the glossary both report that no validation for off-road collision warning was found for GOOSE and the other listed datasets [f5851, f12816]. This is a gap in the research evidence, not proof that GOOSE is unsuitable; the glossary also distinguishes the explicitly identified machine-mounted datasets RELLIS-3D and RUGD from the unverified listings GOOSE and TartanDrive [f5849, f12815, f12816].

relations.note: Both state that GOOSE and TartanDrive were not verified in the research.
Both report no off-road collision-warning validation found for the four listed datasets.
Chapter 7 extends the validation gap to CARLA, Gazebo and Isaac Sim.
